title: SKFAC: Training Neural Networks With Faster Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature
authors: Zedong Tang; Fenlong Jiang; Maoguo Gong; Hao Li; Yue Wu; Fan Yu; Zidong Wang; Min Wang
categories: A: KFAC / EKFAC methods, applications, and substantive evaluations; X8: Linear systems, sparse solvers and Gaussian processes
quantity: Damped inverses of minibatch KFAC factors
method: For a factor lambda I + Y^T Y / M, invert M lambda I + YY^T when the minibatch size M is smaller than the layer dimension; use direct inversion otherwise.
caveat: The fully connected-layer inversion is exact for the chosen damped minibatch factors. The Fisher/Kronecker model and convolutional extensions introduce approximations. This is not an online eigenspace tracker for full EMA factors; the benefit depends on batch size versus width.
relevance_notes: Research note: Swift KFAC (SKFAC) exploits the low rank of minibatch activation and output-derivative Gram matrices. A Woodbury-form identity moves damped factor inversion to a batch-sized system, connecting low-rank preconditioning to efficient KFAC computation.
evidence: Official CVPR proceedings metadata and abstract; targeted full-text passage checked
